exposure: Post-placental insertion of IUCD (Cu-T 380 A and Cu-T 375)
cohort: 100 women undergoing post-placental Cu T insertion either after vaginal delivery or intra-caesarean at a hospital.
finding: The highest incidence of IUCD acceptance (72%) was among women with a gestational age of 38+ to 40 weeks, and the majority of acceptors (73%) had a caesarean section.
mod_finding: Among the women who accepted post-placental IUCD insertion, 73% had a caesarean section, and 27% had a vaginal delivery.
gest_age: 38+ to 40 weeks (72% of patients), beyond 40 weeks (15% of patients)
